notes:
ClipHuntr 0.5.0

New: Stream tab in the editor
- Widen from stream: clip ended too soon? Drag the clip's edges out to pull extra seconds before or after straight from the streamer's VOD (Twitch and Kick). Kick clips get a quick line-up step so the footage matches exactly.
- Stream chat: import the chat from the moment and show it on your video as an overlay box, a side column or bubbles. Drag and resize it right on the preview, set how long messages stay up, and pin individual messages as callouts.
- Show or hide the chat from the timeline with the eye toggle.

Improvements
- The timeline now fills with your clip by default. Zoom out to see how far you can widen it.
- Desktop notifications on Windows now show as ClipHuntr instead of Windows PowerShell.

Fixes
- The highlight on the editor's side tabs no longer drifts onto the wrong tab after resizing the window.
